findings.resolution: Normal-looking pharynx narrowed especially to adults, corroborated by Emergency Care BC clinical presentation33 and MSD.
Nebulised medicine removed. Conditional steroid adjunct supported by RCH and StayWell; no efficacy guarantee. BC explicitly finds insufficient evidence.

Added antibiotic nausea/diarrhoea/allergy and clinical reporting. NHS15–43 and independently authored CDC76–94 corroborate risks; severe breathing/swelling warning and emergency action explicit in NHS and existing airway-emergency materials.
Requested actions/risk claim kinds corrected; original clinical conditions preserved.

resolution: All four medical findings plus source linkage resolved. Targeted revision accepted, unchanged sections inherit first independent reading. Editorial review only; no clinician sign-off.

category_decisions.rationale: CA06.1 acute epiglottitis core covered across14 dimensions: adult/child presentation, causes, airway-first evaluation, conditional treatment and medicine risks, safe feeding, recovery/prevention. Frozen classification first reading retained.

dispute_adjudication.resolution: Prior independent review resolved nebulised-adrenaline scope, retained optional clinician-selected corticosteroids, and preserved age/vaccination and setting conditions.
